findings.detail: C1: 7 consecutive daily runs (trusted run ids 2026-08-13..08-19) -> complete; missing day (>25h gap) breaks chain; stale 48h-gap run does not count; duplicate run id and copied report (same id+hash another day) never count twice; not-ok run breaks chain (count=3 before it). C2: 2 weekly >=7d apart with latest <=7d fresh -> complete; same-week runs count once; latest stale (>7d) window counts 0; all-skipped (not-ok) week does not count. C3: monthly within 35d -> complete; stale -> pending. C4: acked alert completes drill; unacked never counts. C5: identical input -> identical window state; incomplete aggregate -> status=pending (never approved/waived); full aggregate -> complete.
